feature_contract.goal: Restore the complete visible F11 external Dear ImGui window to a legible, independently sized binocular gameplay interface without inheriting the game's small HudScale, while retaining its original shell hit targets, game input routing, and safe eye projection.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only proven F11 external ImGui fixed-function XYZ/orthographic, per-eye matrix and matching scissor projection in the actually packaged R26+HUD renderer; no generic queue sprites, world billboards, GOAL, lens, ordinary HUD scaling, gamepad/FFB, SkyGlow, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Original F11 toggle and Win32 input routing select the external native-density ImGui shell, without turning its source into an original game SpriteNode.
ScopedExternalOverlaySemantic ScreenOverlay2D encloses ImGui_ImplDX9_RenderDrawData at game EndScene, and exact F11 fixed-function XYZ/null-VS/orthographic admission identifies per-draw ownership.
Packaged R26+HUD R30PrepareExternalImGuiProjection reconstructs native-sized finite left/right eye projection and matching scissor and restores original state; OpenXR host composes the eye output.
subcomponents: Remove second 0.55x gameplay HudScale shrink only from the external F11 XY Z ImGui eye-plane builder, in both X and Y while retaining its native-density font and existing centered shell.
Preserve game SpriteNode ScreenHud size, zero/unknown source fallback, separate original scissor ownership and restore, and desktop F11 input/scale unchanged.

Compile positive and negative C++ scale assertions in the packaged owner and run destructive Python tests for producer boundaries, unchanged main HUD, both-eye native scaling and default R30 full-chain parity.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native-sized F11 original orthographic pixels and source font are not multiplied by game HudScale when independently projected into both VR eyes.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Packaged R26 eye scissor and game HUD ownership
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Proven F11 and original game sprites have separate scale policies; both eye matrices and scissor remain paired with original scope and render-state restoration.
Ordinary game HUD still honors 0.55 and 1.5 HudScale; non-ImGui world/effects and desktop ImGui do not enter the external stereo path or change original input.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact-SHA Windows game+host+package, source-domain gate and F11 tests
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Packaged Windows x86 game and x64 host plus full-chain compile, Domain Isolation and existing F11 scoped mutation verifier pass on the final validation-bearing exact SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Quest3/VDXR user reported F11 tiny and upper-right on earlier installed DX9Ex payload; code proves F11 native-density font and full shell are independently scaled but packaged R26+HUD subsequently applies global gameplay HudScale to both eye-plane axes.
diagnosis.root_cause: Packaged R26 R30BuildHudPlaneCoefficients called R30HudContainScale for every flat pass, including external F11's independently rasterised ImGui fixed-function XYZ overlay, multiplying its left/right native glyph and hit-target plane size by game HudScale again.
source_trace: src/overlay/overlay.cpp::render_shell and hooks_overlay.cpp::D3DEndScene create and render F11 with native-density font, live viewport-centered interactive bounds and external ScreenOverlay2D scope.
src/vr/d3d9/stereo_renderer_r30_r26_safe.cpp::R30PrepareExternalImGuiProjection admits only exact source external fixedfn XYZ/orthographic/scissor, then invokes R30BuildHudPlaneCoefficients.

R30BuildHudPlaneCoefficients previously applied gameplay R30HudContainScale for both F11 and game sprites; per-eye hudClipX/hudClipY/hudClipW and transformed per-eye scissor receive the mistakenly shrunken F11 projection.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally enlarge HudScale: the game speed/time/rank HUD would change and historical head/world semantics would risk regression.
Do not rebuild the font atlas every draw: source glyphs were already enlarged and GPU eye projection later reduced them.
Do not force all null-VS or alpha sprites to external F11: precise ExternalOverlaySemanticDepth, XYZ FVF, orthographic projection and game state remain the sole admissions.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: In actual packaged R26+HUD C++ the F11-specific coefficient call passes false and uses unity for both native eye axes, while the normal game HUD call passes true and retains original settings. The general R30 full-chain independent F11 override remains untouched.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ constexpr asserts preserve distinct F11 0.55/1.5 scale and regular game scaling; workflow-wired F11 Python verifier checks exact packaged owner calls, both scale components, strict admission, order before projection, negative mutations and numeric resolution cases.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R30PrepareExternalImGuiProjection has strict exact F11 scope/orthographic/fixedfn gates, computes each eye's head-inverse, relative pose, FOV, viewport and per-command scissor with original state restoration, without borrowing normal game ScreenHud scale.

runtime_evidence: Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active 5/5, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector 2/2, Full Source Impact 3/3 Windows CI verified. No Quest3/VDXR real headset/game-session F11 size, placement or controller/input check; no runtime or deployment upgrade.

ci_evidence.validation_scope: Windows x86 game DLL / x64 OpenXR host / both full-chain & packaged source / MSVC source impact / F11 negative regressions, HMD runtime UNTESTED
